ins.alerts_note: Raised automatically when a grade or school reaches the warning threshold ({threshold}%) and 100%. Emails go to the principal, cluster officer and Ministry Administrators; Ministry Viewers see them here.
ins.alerts_warn: At or above the warning threshold
ins.dashboard_sub: Live figures for academic year {ay}, calculated directly from transactions.
ins.date_basis.IR-03: The selected range is compared with the same range one year earlier.
ins.date_basis.IR-04: Live seat position for the selected academic year (default: admission year).
ins.date_basis.IR-05: Dates filter on the date the threshold was reached.
ins.date_basis.IR-06: Dates filter on submission date; seats are for the selected academic year.
ins.date_basis.IR-07: Dates filter on leaving date; the default academic year is the current school year.
ins.date_basis.IR-08: Registrations by decision date; leavers and transfers out by leaving date.
ins.date_basis.IR-09: Dates filter on submission date. Decision time is counted in working days (weekends and UAE holidays excluded).
ins.date_basis.IR-10: Live seat position for the selected academic year (default: admission year).
ins.desc.IR-01: Applications submitted, offered, accepted, rejected, pending and withdrawn by day, week or month
ins.desc.IR-02: New registrations, transfers in by source, and renewals
ins.desc.IR-03: This year against the same date range last year, with number and % change
ins.desc.IR-04: Capacity, enrolled, held, offered and available seats with utilisation %
ins.desc.IR-05: Schools and grades at or above the warning threshold and at 100%, with the date reached
ins.desc.IR-06: Applications per catchment against available seats, and unmet demand
ins.desc.IR-07: Students leaving the network by reason, sub-reason, cycle, grade and school
ins.desc.IR-08: New registrations and transfers in, minus leavers and transfers out
ins.desc.IR-09: % decided within 2 working days, average decision time, overdue list
ins.desc.IR-10: Bus seat requests against route capacity, and waiting lists
ins.live_note: Figures update live on every load (requirement: at least hourly).
ins.offered_note: "Offer pending" counts applications currently waiting for the parent to accept; accepted offers are counted under Accepted.
ins.reports_sub: All reports are calculated live, can be filtered and exported to Excel in English or Arabic.
